# arianet_volume (Resource)

A block storage volume. Maps to `/cloud/v1/volumes` and its `attach`/`detach`/`resize` actions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "arianet_volume" "data" {
  name       = "data"
  datacenter = "eu-central-1"
  size       = 50
  filesystem = "ext4"
  labels     = { env = "prod" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter code. Changing it replaces the volume.
- `name` (String) Volume name.
- `size` (Number) Size in GB. Growing resizes the volume in place; shrinking replaces it (data is lost).

### Optional

- `filesystem` (String) Filesystem the volume is meant for: `ext4`, `xfs`, or empty.
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs). Lists can be filtered by them with a label selector.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project the resource is in. Defaults to the account's default project; changing it moves the resource.
- `protection_delete` (Boolean) Whether the resource is protected from deletion. Must be set to false before the resource can be destroyed.
- `server_id` (Number) Server the volume is attached to. Do not combine with `arianet_volume_attachment` for the same volume.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `device` (String) Stable device path inside the server, when attached (virtio).
- `device_id_prefix` (String) Part of the volume's ID in the disk serial / by-id name.
- `disk_bus` (String) Disk bus of the datacenter: `virtio` or `scsi`.
- `id` (String) Volume ID.
- `status` (String) Volume status.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arianet_volume.data 456
```
